parsed.post: New best achieved! val_bpb dropped to 0.852252. The subtle fine-tuning of LR and weight decay is continuing to yield incremental improvements. I'll now try to slightly increase the learning rate to see if we can escape this local minimum or if we've reached the ceiling with the current configuration.
parsed.description: Slightly increase learning rate and decrease weight decay to test if a more aggressive optimization path yields better results before hitting a plateau.
